zh.name: overview
zh.caption: 三個問題，建立資安地圖
zh.description: 先界定保護目標，再選控制措施，最後以授權測試驗證；箭頭表示學習與設計順序。

items.title: 我們要保護什麼？
items.body: CIA：保密性、完整性、可用性

items.title: 要怎麼保護？
items.body: Security Controls：實體、技術、管理控制

items.title: 怎麼知道保護有效？
items.body: Ethical Hacking：經授權測試、找漏洞、改善風險

en.name: overview
en.caption: Three questions build a security map
en.description: Define protection goals, choose controls, then verify them through authorized testing. Arrows show learning and design order.

items.title: What are we protecting?
items.body: CIA: confidentiality, integrity and availability

items.title: How do we protect it?
items.body: Security controls: physical, technical and administrative

items.title: How do we verify protection?
items.body: Ethical hacking: authorized testing, vulnerability discovery and risk reduction

zh.name: encryption
zh.caption: 加密與解密：由明文到密文，再還原
zh.description: 密文只示意呈現形式，並非實際加密計算結果。銀行密碼是虛構教學資料；實際加密另需適當模式與金鑰管理。

items.title: 原始資料：明文 Plaintext
items.body: 我的銀行密碼是 123456

items.title: 使用加密演算法與金鑰 → 密文 Ciphertext
items.body:
7F A2 9C 41 ...
示意字串，非實際加密結果

items.title: 使用適當金鑰解密
items.body: 還原原始內容

en.name: encryption
en.caption: Encryption and decryption: plaintext, ciphertext and recovery
en.description: The ciphertext illustrates a representation, not an actual encryption result. The bank password is fictional teaching data. Real encryption also requires a suitable mode and key management.

items.title: Original data: plaintext
items.body: My bank password is 123456

items.title: Encryption algorithm and key → ciphertext
items.body:
7F A2 9C 41 ...
Illustrative bytes, not an actual encryption result

items.title: Decrypt using the appropriate key
items.body: Recover the original content

zh.name: defense
zh.caption: 五層縱深防禦
zh.description: 以機密資料系統為例。箭頭表示逐層閱讀，不表示所有攻擊都必須依序通過五層；各層共同處理不同失敗情況。

items.title: 第 1 層｜Physical
items.body: 保全、門禁與機房管制

items.title: 第 2 層｜Identity
items.body: 身分驗證、MFA 與權限限制

items.title: 第 3 層｜Network
items.body: 防火牆與網路區隔

items.title: 第 4 層｜Data
items.body: 加密、資料存取控制

items.title: 第 5 層｜Detection & Recovery
items.body: 監控、備份、復原與事件應變

en.name: defense
en.caption: Five layers of defense in depth
en.description: A confidential-data system example. Arrows indicate reading order, not a path every attack must follow. The layers address different failure conditions together.

items.title: Layer 1 | Physical
items.body: Security guards, access control and server-room restrictions

items.title: Layer 2 | Identity
items.body: Authentication, MFA and permission restrictions

items.title: Layer 3 | Network
items.body: Firewalls and network segmentation

items.title: Layer 4 | Data
items.body: Encryption and data access controls

items.title: Layer 5 | Detection & Recovery
items.body: Monitoring, backup, recovery and incident response

zh.name: hats
zh.caption: 白帽、黑帽與灰帽：先看授權與目的
zh.description: 三列是角色比較，不是先後流程。動機、授權、實際行為與適用法律須一起判斷；帽子名稱不構成法律豁免。

items.title: White Hat（白帽駭客）
items.body:
在有效授權範圍內執行安全測試，目的是找出並改善安全問題。
例子：公司聘請資安顧問進行滲透測試。

items.title: Black Hat（黑帽駭客）
items.body:
通常為竊取、破壞或其他惡意目的，未經授權侵害系統。
例子：入侵公司資料庫，偷取客戶帳號。

items.title: Grey Hat（灰帽駭客）
items.body:
可能沒有直接惡意或獲利目的，卻在缺乏授權時測試。
例子：未經同意驗證網站漏洞，之後才通知站長。

en.name: hats
en.caption: White, black and grey hats: authorization and purpose
en.description: The rows compare roles, not consecutive steps. Consider motive, authorization, actual conduct and applicable law together; a hat label provides no legal exemption.

items.title: White hat
items.body:
Tests security within valid authorization to find and improve security problems.
Example: a company hires a security consultant for a penetration test.

items.title: Black hat
items.body:
Typically compromises systems without authorization for theft, damage or another malicious purpose.
Example: breaking into a company database to steal customer accounts.

items.title: Grey hat
items.body:
May lack a directly malicious or profit motive but tests without authorization.
Example: verifying a website vulnerability without consent, then notifying its owner.

zh.name: roe
zh.caption: 虛構案例：公司的滲透測試約定
zh.description: 192.0.2.0/24 是保留供文件與教學使用的位址範圍；192.0.2.11 不會因鄰近而自動納入授權。

items.title: 允許方式
items.body: 指定的安全性驗證活動

items.title: 禁止事項
items.body: DoS、擅自刪除資料、超範圍存取

items.title: 事件通報
items.body: 發現系統異常立即通報指定窗口

en.name: roe
en.caption: Fictional example: penetration-testing agreement
en.description: 192.0.2.0/24 is reserved for documentation and teaching. The neighboring 192.0.2.11 does not automatically enter the authorized scope.

items.title: Scope
items.body: The 192.0.2.10 server

items.title: Testing time
items.body: Saturday, 10:00–14:00

items.title: Permitted methods
items.body: The specified security-verification activities

items.title: Prohibited activities
items.body: DoS, unauthorized data deletion and out-of-scope access

items.title: Incident reporting
items.body: Immediately report system abnormalities to the designated contact

zh.name: testing
zh.caption: 從安全測試到降低風險
zh.description: 五個步驟依序連接；修補由負責團隊執行，再以複測驗證改善。單次測試未發現漏洞，不代表系統完全安全。

items.title: 取得授權
items.body: 確認能測哪些系統及活動

items.title: 找出弱點
items.body: 辨識可能的安全漏洞

items.title: 驗證影響
items.body: 在限制內確認弱點是否可被利用

items.title: 提出報告
items.body: 說明證據、影響與修補建議

items.title: 修補與複測
items.body: 由負責團隊修補，再確認改善是否有效

en.name: testing
en.caption: From security testing to risk reduction
en.description: The five steps connect in order. The responsible team remediates findings, followed by retesting. Finding no vulnerability in one test does not establish complete security.

items.title: Obtain authorization
items.body: Confirm which systems and activities may be tested

items.title: Find weaknesses
items.body: Identify potential security vulnerabilities

items.title: Verify impact
items.body: Determine within the agreed limits whether a weakness is exploitable

items.title: Report findings
items.body: Explain evidence, impact and remediation recommendations

items.title: Remediate and retest
items.body: The responsible team fixes the issue, then verifies whether the improvement works

zh.name: decision
zh.caption: 先辨認問題，再找決定性線索
zh.description: 四個分支是平行分類。真實事件可同時涉及多類問題；單選題依題幹要求的主要問題選擇。

items.title: 駭客角色
items.body:
Authorization / Permission
White Hat、Grey Hat、Black Hat

items.title: 資訊受到什麼影響
items.body:
Read / Modify / Unavailable
Confidentiality、Integrity、Availability

items.title: 安全控制種類
items.body:
Physical / Technical
Security Guard、Firewall 等

items.title: 安全測試目的
items.body:
Goal / Primary purpose
找出漏洞、降低風險

en.name: decision
en.caption: Identify the question, then find decisive clues
en.description: The four branches are parallel categories. A real incident can involve several categories; choose according to the main issue asked by a single-answer question.

items.title: Hacker role
items.body:
Authorization / Permission
White hat, grey hat, black hat

items.title: Impact on information
items.body:
Read / Modify / Unavailable
Confidentiality, integrity, availability

items.title: Control category
items.body:
Physical / Technical
Security guard, firewall and related controls

items.title: Testing purpose
items.body:
Goal / Primary purpose
Find vulnerabilities and reduce risk

zh.name: hash
zh.caption: 不同內容通常產生不同的 Hash
zh.description: 兩個輸入平行比較；摘要 A／B 是概念標籤，未顯示實際 SHA-256 結果。碰撞在數學上存在，安全性要求是難以找到可利用的碰撞。

items.title: 輸入 A
items.body:
病人血壓：120
↓ SHA-256
產生摘要 A

items.title: 輸入 B
items.body:
病人血壓：180
↓ SHA-256
產生摘要 B（通常不同於 A）

en.name: hash
en.caption: Different content usually produces different hashes
en.description: The two inputs are compared in parallel. Digest A/B are conceptual labels, not computed SHA-256 results. Collisions exist mathematically; security requires that exploitable collisions be difficult to find.

items.title: Input A
items.body:
Patient blood pressure: 120
↓ SHA-256
Produces digest A

items.title: Input B
items.body:
Patient blood pressure: 180
↓ SHA-256
Produces digest B, usually different from A

zh.name: compare
zh.caption: Encryption 與 Hashing 的方向不同
zh.description: 加密設計有對應的解密程序；雜湊沒有解密操作。低熵輸入仍可能被逐一猜測及計算摘要比對，這是猜輸入，不是解密。

items.title: Encryption｜加密
items.body:
明文
↓ 使用演算法與金鑰
密文
↑ 使用適當金鑰可還原明文

items.title: Hashing｜雜湊
items.body:
原始資料
↓ 雜湊函數
摘要
沒有對應的解密操作

en.name: compare
en.caption: Encryption and hashing have different directions
en.description: Encryption has a corresponding decryption procedure; hashing has no decryption operation. Low-entropy inputs can still be guessed and hashed for comparison. That is guessing an input, not decrypting a digest.

items.title: Encryption
items.body:
Plaintext
↓ Algorithm and key
Ciphertext
↑ The appropriate key can recover the plaintext

items.title: Hashing
items.body:
Original data
↓ Hash function
Digest
No corresponding decryption operation

zh.name: tls
zh.caption: TLS 1.3：憑證式 ECDHE 連線的簡化時序
zh.description: 實線箭頭表示瀏覽器送往伺服器；虛線箭頭表示伺服器回覆，並非「未加密」。橘框表示本機計算或驗證。省略 EncryptedExtensions、金鑰排程細節、用戶端憑證與其他分支；這不是封包擷取。Certificate 起的伺服器交握訊息受交握金鑰保護。

items.title: ClientHello + key_share
items.body: 瀏覽器提供支援參數與公開金鑰分享值。

items.title: ServerHello + key_share
items.body: 伺服器選定參數，回覆其公開金鑰分享值。

items.title: 各自計算共享祕密並導出金鑰
items.body: ECDHE 與 HKDF 建立交握金鑰；後續依金鑰排程導出應用流量金鑰，不直接傳送共享祕密。

items.title: Certificate
items.body: 伺服器傳送憑證鏈，提供公鑰與身分／網域綁定資料。

items.title: CertificateVerify
items.body: 伺服器以簽章證明持有對應私鑰，並綁定交握內容。

items.title: Finished（伺服器）
items.body: 以交握祕密與交握內容驗證值，確認此次交握。

items.title: 驗證憑證、網域、簽章與 Finished
items.body: 瀏覽器檢查信任鏈、名稱、期限與適用限制等；失敗時不繼續可信連線。此框彙整驗證責任，非精確執行時間。

items.title: Finished（瀏覽器）
items.body: 瀏覽器完成其交握確認；本例省略用戶端憑證驗證。

items.title: 加密的 HTTP Request
items.body: 用應用流量金鑰與 AES-GCM 等 AEAD 保護請求。

items.title: 加密的 HTTP Response
items.body: 伺服器以其方向的流量金鑰保護回覆；CA 不參與每次交握。

en.name: tls
en.caption: TLS 1.3: simplified certificate-based ECDHE exchange
en.description: Solid arrows mean browser-to-server messages; dashed arrows mean server replies, not unencrypted traffic. Orange boxes indicate local computation or validation. EncryptedExtensions, key-schedule details, client certificates and other branches are omitted; this is not a packet capture. Server handshake messages from Certificate onward are protected with handshake keys.

items.title: ClientHello + key_share
items.body: The browser offers supported parameters and a public key share.

items.title: ServerHello + key_share
items.body: The server selects parameters and returns its public key share.

items.title: Compute a shared secret and derive keys locally
items.body: ECDHE and HKDF establish handshake keys. The key schedule later derives application traffic keys; the shared secret is not sent directly.

items.title: Certificate
items.body: The server sends its certificate chain, carrying public-key and identity/domain binding information.

items.title: CertificateVerify
items.body: A signature proves possession of the corresponding private key and binds the handshake transcript.

items.title: Finished (server)
items.body: A verification value based on handshake secrets and the transcript authenticates this handshake.

items.title: Validate certificate, domain, signature and Finished
items.body: The browser checks the trust chain, name, validity and applicable constraints. Failure prevents continuing a trusted connection. This box groups validation responsibilities rather than prescribing exact execution timing.

items.title: Finished (browser)
items.body: The browser sends its handshake confirmation; client-certificate authentication is omitted in this example.

items.title: Encrypted HTTP request
items.body: Application traffic keys and an AEAD such as AES-GCM protect the request.

items.title: Encrypted HTTP response
items.body: The server protects its reply with traffic keys for its direction. The CA does not participate in every handshake.
